Current head candidate-B has acceptance command output exit 0, all required artifacts verified and no open findings, so the claim is READY_FOR_PROTECTED_MERGE; integration and the receipt remain. With findings remaining it would be INCOMPLETE; a BLOCKED claim must cite durable evidence of the actual external boundary. COMPLETE is reserved for protected merge, readback and an immutable closeout receipt. Ordinary CI is only internal correctness, and a provider timeout is not a model rejection.
